+- 01M5QWGWNFDVP77YAW9ACHVXY1

+position_ordinal: 8b80
+title: 'MTP: define drafter behaviour with maxKVSize (rotating) and quantized main KV caches'
+---
+## What
+The Qwen MTP drafter cache is a plain `KVCacheSimple` (`Qwen35MTPPredictor.newCache`, Libraries/MLXLLM/Models/Qwen35MTP.swift). It never rotates or quantizes. When the main full-attention caches use `maxKVSize` (rotating) or KV quantization (`kvBits`, `KVCachePlan`), the rule "drafter = main − 1" (by `processedTokenCount`) and the drafter memory use are not defined.
+
+- [ ] Rotating main cache: make the drafter cache rotate with the same window (`RotatingKVCache` from `makeAttentionKVCache(parameters:)`), so that its memory stays bounded. Check that the alignment checks compare logical token counts, not stored rows.
+- [ ] Quantized main cache: decide from a measurement whether the drafter cache also quantizes (with the same `kvBits` / `kvGroupSize`) or stays bf16. It is one layer, so bf16 can be correct. Record the decision in a doc comment in Qwen35MTP.swift.
+- [ ] If a combination is not supported, `MTPSpeculativeTokenIterator` must change to passthrough with a clear `passthroughReason`, and must not trap or produce wrong tokens.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] With `maxKVSize` smaller than the generated length, MTP greedy output equals plain greedy output with the same `maxKVSize`, and the drafter cache size stays bounded.
+- [ ] With `kvBits = 8`, MTP greedy output equals plain greedy output with the same KV setting, or the stream changes to passthrough with a reason. A test asserts which of the two happens.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Tests/MLXLMTests/Qwen35MTPTests.swift: a rotating-cache equality test and a bounded drafter-size test; a quantized-KV test.
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests && xcrun xctest .build/out/Products/Debug/MLXLMTests.xctest` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #mtp #qwen38 #kv-cache
\ No newline at end of file
